say.en: Oh! Someone new at the post! Good to have you here. I'm Bavko, the postmaster of the Sky Post.
say.sl: Oh! Nekdo nov na pošti! Lepo, da si tu. Sem Bavko, poštar Nebesne pošte.

say.en: Out here, nobody carries the mail alone. Pick a creature to travel with you.
say.sl: Tu nihče ne nosi pošte sam. Izberi bitje, ki bo potovalo s tabo.

say.en: I have a note for Tobolko, down by the meadow. Can you take it to him?
say.sl: Imam sporočilo za Tobolka, tam pri travniku. Mu ga lahko neseš?

say.en: Wonderful! Here's the note. Tobolko is by the meadow, west of here.
say.sl: Odlično! Tu je sporočilo. Tobolko je pri travniku, zahodno od tod.
Ni treba hiteti. Pisma znajo počakati.

say.en: Tobolko is waiting for that note. He's by the meadow.
say.sl: Tobolko čaka na tisto sporočilo. Najdeš ga pri travniku.

say.en: The wind is gentle today. Good weather for letters.
say.sl: Veter je danes nežen. Pravo vreme za pisma.
